Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: committed-completion variant of the selected cinematic game room.
Input image: the original ordinary rented room scene; preserve exactly its room geometry, viewpoint, wide 16:9 framing, window, bed, door, bookshelf, city, seated adult back-view figure and their positions.
Primary request: Change only the small working area at right to represent an affordable completed desk/chair/lighting improvement. Replace the old rickety desk with a tidy solid wood desk of similar footprint, a comfortable simple upholstered office chair, and a better adjustable warm desk lamp. Neaten cables, add a modest task organizer and a small healthy plant. This is still the same modest rental apartment, not a luxury renovation. Keep the same laptop, no other technology upgrade, no new rooms, no wardrobe or identity change. Keep the existing warm amber/cool dawn color contrast and semi-realistic painterly cinema style. Maintain all object positions used for game hotspots. No text, logo, watermark or UI.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 16:9 full-screen contextual environment for the opportunity and business chapters of a semi-realistic cinematic Chinese life strategy game set initially in 2020.
Primary request: Intimate, beautifully art-directed close wide view across a modest wooden work desk by a rain-streaked window at blue dawn, inside an ordinary Chinese rented apartment. Unbranded 2019 laptop at right with a subdued dark blank screen, worn notebook and pencil at center, a few loose blank pages, small ceramic cup and a plant, amber desk lamp above left. Distant apartment skyline through window, shallow atmospheric detail but no excessive blur.
Style: premium painterly cinematic realism, tactile wood/paper/glass, cool teal-blue shadows and warm amber practical light, restrained hopeful mood, consistent with a realistic small rented room. No futuristic tech. The first steps of an ordinary person's new life.
Composition: desk objects lower/right half, upper-left 40% calm dark wall/window reflection for an editable game chapter title; lower central60% calm shadow for foreground paper-like editable gameplay UI overlay. Wide scene, strong depth, no dashboards or existing UI.
Constraints: original art only, no readable writing, no labels, no numbers, blank notebook pages and screen, no charts or financial price information, no logos, no UI, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide 16:9 background for a memory and life journal chapter in a semi-realistic cinematic Chinese life strategy game.
Primary request: A quiet ordinary Chinese city seen through an old apartment window at winter blue hour, 2020 feeling. Close window frame at left, rain droplets on glass, layers of apartments and tiny warm windows outside, overhead cables, soft early city lights. In the near lower-right a small wooden sill with closed unmarked notebook, ceramic cup and a plant. No people, signs or readable texts.
Style: rich but restrained painterly cinematic realism, wistful human atmosphere, desaturated midnight teal and warm copper glints, real tactile glass/wood, hopeful and reflective, not cyberpunk or dystopian. No fantasy portal or time travel device.
Composition: expansive city and reflected window light in upper/right half, left40% quieter dark wall for editable title; bottom central60% quiet dark midtones for a foreground journal UI. Wide immersive scene, clear composition, original game art.
Constraints: no typography, no baked interface, no logos, no brands, no recognizable real address or location, no charts, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide 16:9 environment background for the account book and saved records chapter of a cinematic life strategy game in an ordinary Chinese apartment.
Primary request: Warm close low-angle view of a modest worn wooden desk at night, a large open blank accounting notebook at lower right, simple pen, unbranded small calculator with dark unlit screen, blank envelopes, an old simple desk lamp at upper right casting amber light, a ceramic cup. Dark blue rainy window behind. The scene should feel like a person quietly sorting out their life after work, not a bank, office dashboard or finance advertisement.
Style: premium semi-realistic painterly cinema lighting with tactile paper and wood, deep teal shadows, soft brass and warm parchment highlights, gentle depth of field, grounded and personal. Keep notebook pages blank for editable game data to be drawn separately.
Composition: wide 16:9, dark low-detail left half and central area for readable foreground game ledger interface; notebook/lamp clustered at right, mood and space are the focus.
Constraints: original assets, no visible money/banknotes, no bank cards, no private documents, no text or numbers, no logos, no charts, no baked UI, no watermark.
